description: For the person's own booking or service request: the messages between them and the MCC desk on that booking (the same thread as on their page), whether the desk still owes a reply, and whether a new message can be sent. Needs their private link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= or t= value from that link

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…) or the status link from a request email (…/requests/SR-…?t=…)

ref.description: Instead of link: the reference, e.g. SR-AB12CD

name: booking_messages
title: Messages on a booking or request
